definitions.gloss: short time; brief period; short duration
definitions.explanation: A relatively brief span of time. Often used as a modifier with で or の to describe doing something quickly or in a limited time.

examples.japanese: {短時間|たんじかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll finish it in a short time.

examples.japanese: {短時間|たんじかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{勤務|きんむ}→勤務：04545_kinmu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦しています→する：00392_suru⟧。

{短時間|たんじかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}せた→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧だ。
examples.english: The fact that we could achieve this much in such a short time is thanks to the effort of the entire team.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time). Used as a noun, often followed by で (in a short time) or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (short-time ~). Very common in work contexts for part-time or reduced-hours positions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短時間|たんじかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in a short time)
- {短時間|たんじかん}{勤務|きんむ} (short-hour work)
- {短時間|たんじかん}{労働|ろうどう} (short-time work/employment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧: long time — the antonym
- ⟦{短期間|たんきかん}→短期間：17178_tankikan⟧: short period — measured in days, weeks, or months rather than hours
